name: Please Be Quiet Utah 2019

venue.name: Samuel Baird's House Saratoga Springs, Utah, 84045
venue.address: Address will be emailed to competitors after registration closes.

information: Everyone is welcome but remember that this competition does not have events like 2x2, 3x3 and 4x4. It consists of the blindfolded events, FMC and Feet. We will be providing waffles for breakfast and will be buying pizza for lunch, if you have any dietary restrictions please let us know while registering so we can do our best to accomodate you.
